hero.title: From Photo to Prediction
hero.subtitle: Discover what happens step-by-step from the moment an image is uploaded to the final AI result.

steps.title: Upload Image
steps.desc: Select a clear dog photograph from your camera roll or desktop (JPG, JPEG, PNG up to 10MB).

steps.title: Image Preparation
steps.desc: Client-side image validation formats pixels to 224x224 RGB tensors normalized via ImageNet parameters.

steps.title: CNN Analysis
steps.desc: Convolutional layers process visual patterns across facial structure, ears, coat density, and body contours.

steps.title: Breed Probabilities
steps.desc: The final Softmax classification layer computes normalized probabilities across 120 Stanford Dogs classes.

steps.title: Prediction Result
steps.desc: Displays the top predicted breed alongside calibrated confidence scores and inference latency.

steps.title: Grad-CAM Attention Map
steps.desc: Visual heatmaps highlight spatial image regions contributing to the neural network decision.

steps.title: Breed Discovery
steps.desc: Explore detailed breed profiles, characteristics, origin, temperament traits, and similar classes.

cta.title: Try It Yourself
cta.subtitle: Test the DogBreedID classification interface with your own dog photo.
